rules.question: How is "this step was asked to stop" thrown?
rules.decision: concept audit M79 (D114 fix wave, task F4)
must_match: throw KindedError( ErrorKind::Cancelled, "opening the database was stopped");
must_not_match: throw Cancelled("opening the database was stopped");
rules.note: A stop is thrown as Cancelled or a type derived from it (ui::JobCancelled, audio::OpenCancelled), so the kind is built once. Reading the kind back (e.kind() == ErrorKind::Cancelled) is a catch, not a throw, and passes.
